svg.title: Urchin — all layers
svg.desc: 34-key Urchin split keyboard in typing orientation, with two thumbs per hand. Lower legends show hold actions or chord modifiers. Tinted HELD thumbs mark layer selectors, not new bindings. Tri requires both layer thumbs. Down triangles are transparent; dashes are disabled. Tri inherits R Ctrl from Right. Colors use Modus Operandi.
svg.metadata: keyboard.toml sha256: c1fb8d153dc5a407dad731f74c4a6478e7a2cd3451cde3c9c3a35d65648dd1d6; Modus Operandi palette; schematic key placement.
svg.text: 34 keys · two thumbs per hand · US symbol legends
Tap: large legend · Hold: colored lower legend · ▽ transparent · — disabled

g.text: Tap for typing. Hold a colored thumb to access its matching layer.

svg.text: Tri: hold Tab + Bksp. Thumb combos (50 ms): left pair = Esc · right pair = Del.
Inner thumbs = Caps Word: Enter + Space (Enter + R Ctrl on Right / Tri).
HELD marks a selector. Small chord labels are simultaneous modifiers. BT 0–5 select profiles; Clear BT forgets the active bond.
Source: keyboard.toml · schematic placement · Modus Operandi palette
